name: @omp-dev-team/cliproxy
description: Register a CLIProxyAPI gateway as an OpenAI-compatible model provider in OMP.
comment: The extension probes the gateway's /v1/models (Bearer auth), emits the ~/.omp/agent/models.yml provider block (api: openai-completions, discovery: openai-models-list), registers a /cliproxy command, and — when CLIPROXY_URL/CLIPROXY_API_KEY are set — registers the provider live. install.sh/ps1 drive the same CLI.
